patch.value: Implement native claim and release with published CLI parity
Match locked 2026.10.7 ownership transitions, refusal envelopes, durable history, and concurrent claim arbitration.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Plan: implement native ownership transitions under the existing item lock and journal; compare item/history bytes and refusal envelopes with locked CLI 2026.10.7; verify a two-process race, behavioral revert, and both release-check environments.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Implementation now matches explicit-author claim/release storage and compact JSON receipts. Published probes established preset precedence, repeated claim no-op, empty release maintenance history, strict-policy release refusal, and terminal claim force override. Six simultaneous two-process claim races produced exactly one winner and valid published-verifier history. Final differential rerun and coverage gates remain to verify.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: All four live ownership differential tests passed against locked CLI 2026.10.7: exact item/history bytes, complete success/refusal JSON and exit codes, active/stale lock behavior, and six independent two-process races. Behavioral revert replaced both SDK ownership methods with unavailable-command stubs while retaining compiled CLI/test surfaces: all four tests failed at runtime (exit 101), including zero race winners; source was restored afterward.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Initial release-check passed all 214 tests but correctly refused below-100 coverage. Added consumer and unit checks for invalid settings/authors, missing items, lock IO faults, foreign claim diagnostics, skipped claims, and interrupted release history append followed by journal recovery; no coverage exclusions or lowered thresholds.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Coverage refinement now includes terminal force/no-force, strict release refusal, takeover warnings, idempotent claims, in-progress release warnings, and retained closing summaries in the unit build as well as the live oracle build. Receipt dispatch returns its writer result directly, preserving failure propagation. Full thresholds remain unchanged.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Final-source behavioral revert repeated successfully: the unchanged four ownership differential tests compiled and all failed at runtime (exit 101); the existing create/update/comment/close differential passed as a positive control with ownership reverted. Restored source. Coverage refinement now exercises measured bounded lock wait in both consumer and unit builds.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Coverage diagnostics now reach 100 percent for lines, functions, regions, and branches after adding principal-only release and warn-policy ownership cases. Clean release gates and the isolated HOME gate remain to be run.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Implementation verified: both clean just release-check runs passed, including disposable HOME with global/system Git configuration disabled and no Git identity supplied. Each ran 219 tests in ordinary and instrumented passes; all 3367 lines, 290 functions, 5090 regions and 696 branches were covered at 100 percent. Locked CLI 2026.10.7 byte/envelope comparisons and all six independent two-process races passed in every gate. Behavioral revert compiled and failed all four ownership tests; the existing mutation differential passed as positive control. Feature remains open for orchestrator verification; ownership is being released.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Resume the existing #68 candidate at ea29da3aa8265b597595f0ed9a3c95be08da0dbb for a minimal Windows test-only correction. Run 37709763894 passes all tests but misses the diagnostic lock-read error and its outer propagation regions at mutation.rs 1828 and 1889. Extend existing unit and SDK fixtures with a real exclusive Windows file handle, exact OS error 32, unchanged item/history bytes, and successful retry after fixture cleanup. Preserve production code, coverage thresholds and the locked 2026.10.7 oracle. Primary codec repair remains independent in PR #72. Companion session pm-cli-website-session-2026-10-10 is linked through https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli-companion/tree/main/.agents/pm.

value.command: env HOME=$(mktemp -d) RUSTUP_HOME="${RUSTUP_HOME:-$HOME/.rustup}" CARGO_HOME="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}" GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 just release-check

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: The existing Windows aggregate covered 3362/3363 lines and 5085/5087 regions: both missing regions are one diagnostic-read error propagation chain. Unit and SDK fixtures now use a real Windows exclusive read handle (share_mode(0)); they preserve item/history bytes and require a successful retry. Production code and the 2026.10.7 oracle remain unchanged. Windows all-target/all-feature cross-check and strict target Clippy passed. Required claim/release differential passed all four tests. The diagnostic regression passes; swallowing the native diagnostic-read error compiled but failed it at runtime (exit 101), then production source was restored byte-for-byte.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Final test-only correction verified: both ordinary and isolated-HOME just release-check passed, each with 219 ordinary and 219 instrumented tests. Coverage is exactly 3367/3367 lines, 5090/5090 regions, 290/290 functions and 696/696 branches (all 100 percent). Both gates include required locked 2026.10.7 oracle, formatting, strict Clippy, private-item rustdoc, identity audit, Cargo audit and changelog check. PM-linked Windows GNU all-target/all-feature check and strict Clippy also passed. Native Windows execution remains the hosted CI receipt for the append commit. No production source, dependencies, oracle semantics, coverage thresholds or exclusions changed. Releasing ownership without closing; orchestrator verifies.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: At append head 1a6d111685209f65023b7e08efd0c5e11af1592a, run 38022248758 passes the Windows exclusive-handle unit fixture but the new SDK fixture fails its exact-path assertion. Workspace::discover canonicalizes the storage root, whereas TempDir retains another Windows spelling; the assertion compared those spellings. Correct the fixture lock path to Workspace::pm_root().join("locks/sample-conv.lock") and keep the exact OS error assertion. This is a test expectation correction, not a production error-propagation change. Previous ordinary and isolated-HOME Linux aggregates passed; latest native Windows evidence is still required.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Canonical SDK lock-path correction verified by the linked diagnostic consumer regression, Windows GNU all-target/all-feature check and strict target Clippy. Repeated the native-only error-swallowing proof with the corrected fixture: it compiled and failed at runtime (exit 101), then restored source byte-for-byte and the linked positive test passed. Production source, dependencies and locked 2026.10.7 oracle are unchanged from the original feature head. Local full ordinary and isolated-HOME receipts belong to append 1a6d111; the next append requires its own native CI aggregate receipt. Releasing ownership without closing.
